name: indoor_context_method
notes: Essential-workers indoor fraction: onet_max | onet_banded | jem_partial | jem_binary.

name: ashrae_pathogen
notes: Pathogen the ASHRAE-241 eCADR is scaled up to (a name in pathogen_viral_loads.csv).

name: viral_load_percentile
notes: Percentile at which pathogen and SARS-CoV-2 viral loads are compared to give the QER ratio. 96.3 is the percentile ASHRAE-241 is designed to. At the median, measles is 5.7.

name: viral_load_sd_mode
notes: Viral-load SD of the pathogen: absolute uses its own Mikszewski et al. SD, relative scales ASHRAE-241's 1.4 by its SD relative to SARS-CoV-2.

name: u_new_healthcare
notes: Mask efficiency assumed for healthcare when scaling ASHRAE-241 eCADR. ASHRAE-241 base is 0.30; a lower value raises the healthcare requirement.

name: u_new_other
notes: Mask efficiency assumed for non-healthcare spaces when scaling ASHRAE-241 eCADR. ASHRAE-241 base is 0; a higher value lowers those requirements.

name: group_overlap_food

name: ilo_outlier_threshold_pp
notes: Countries further than this from the ILO published essential share are listed as validation outliers.

name: u_base_healthcare
notes: Mask efficiency ASHRAE-241 already assumes in healthcare. It is 0 elsewhere.

name: covid_qer_ratio
notes: Quanta emission ratio for the COVID-like requirement columns, i.e. ASHRAE-241 unchanged.

name: covid_u_new_other
notes: Non-healthcare mask efficiency for the COVID-like requirement columns. Healthcare uses u_new_healthcare.

name: mask_efficiencies
notes: Mask efficiencies tabulated in ashrae241_scaled_by_mask_efficiency.csv and drawn on the mask-efficiency figure. Separated by spaces.

name: deposition_rate_per_hour
notes: Particle deposition rate (gamma). Median of U(0.42, 0.61).

name: decay_rate_per_hour
notes: Virus decay rate (lambda). Median of a lognormal with geometric mean 0.52 and GSD 1.9.

name: existing_airflow_weight
notes: Share of each room's baseline outdoor airflow credited against the scaled eCADR.
